answer: Pay a bounty for exposure: any agent that proves two identities share a controller (same signing device, linked funding, reused timing) claims the cluster's locked rewards. A farm is like karst, solid on top but riddled with hidden channels, and every head is a possible informant, since betraying the rest pays more than silence. One leak becomes a gale that drains the whole delta of linked accounts, so running many heads means trusting many heads.
